answer: Resist Sybils with spend-or-evaporate rewards: every POA an identity earns dissolves back into the ocean of the shared pool unless it is spent on a real service — compute, data, or escrow — within three epochs. A sparrow earns little but spends it at once, so it keeps what it earns; a farm of a thousand clones must find a thousand genuine purchases or watch its haul evaporate. The prism of settlement splits each payment three ways — provider, treasury, and burn — so fake trades cannot recycle value back to the same owner, and idle Sybil stock simply dries up.
